source.title: ITU Sierra Leone national numbering plan communication of 24.II.2020

phones.notes: ITU confirms country code +232 and two-digit NDC plus six-digit subscriber structure for eight-digit national significant numbers. Cancelled NDCs 21, 40, 44, 50 and 55 are intentionally excluded; 31 and 35 are included from later ITU additions. Generated values are synthetic and not checked for live assignment.

national_identification_number.label: National Identification Number

source.title: Sierra Leone NCRA biometric registration process

national_identification_number.notes: NCRA confirms a National Identification Number is generated and assigned after civil registration, but the public official page does not confirm a number grammar. The 11-digit template is an unconfirmed synthetic placeholder.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: PRADO Sierra Leone ordinary passport SLE-AO-01001

passport.notes: PRADO confirms the ordinary passport document; visible specimen data shows a seven-digit passport number. This is sample-verified only, not a confirmed national numbering rule.

personal_number.label: Personal Number

source.title: PRADO Sierra Leone ordinary passport SLE-AO-01001

personal_number.notes: Visible PRADO specimen data shows Personal No as nine digits. Kept sample_verified because a single specimen is not enough to establish a general rule.
